name: defold
description: Defold skill plus a read-only reference checker. The checker (Python, stdlib only) finds what Bob will fail to resolve: compiled-suffix paths in game.project, quoted /paths inside embedded data, require() modules, case mismatches and library paths. The skill covers the footguns that cost a build or a silent run — Bob's truncated and generated-file errors, JDK 25, a headless engine that keeps running after a Lua error, proxy socket clashes, Remotery port collisions — and a smoke test under timeout.
